bio.text: Landon C. Dais represents District 77 in the New York State Assembly, according to the Assembly's member directory.
His official biography describes him as an attorney who lives in Highbridge in the Bronx, and says he was born and raised in New York.
According to that biography, he holds a B.A. from Morehouse College, an M.S. in real estate development from Columbia University and a J.D. from Hofstra Law School.
